questions.question: What is the '1600xx' numbering series to be used for, according to the RBI's recent directive?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Transactional calls to customers.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **RBI directs banks to use '1600xx' numbering series for transactional calls and '140xx' for promotional calls to prevent financial fraud.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The '1600xx' numbering series is designated for transactional calls, while '140xx' is for promotional calls.**
 
• The RBI's directive aims to prevent financial frauds that often occur through voice calls and SMS.
 
• The directive also mandates banks and financial entities to monitor and clean their customer databases using the Mobile Number Revocation List (MNRL).
 
• The compliance deadline for all regulated entities is set for March 31, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mobile Number Revocation List (MNRL)__

 __
 
• Developed by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT).
 
• Used to monitor and clean customer databases of regulated entities to prevent misuse of disconnected numbers.
 
 
 
• Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)__
 
 
• Responsible for regulating telecom services in India.
 
• Issued the guidelines on commercial communication through voice calls and SMS to ensure consumer protection.

questions.question: Where did Prime Minister Modi inaugurate the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **PM Narendra Modi** will inaugurate the **Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025** on 17 January at **Bharat Mandapam**, New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **expo** will be held from **January 17-22, 2025** across three venues: **Bharat Mandapam**, **Yashobhoomi** in Delhi, and **India Expo Center and Mart** in Greater Noida.
 
• The event will feature **nine concurrent shows**, **20+ conferences and pavilions**, and state sessions showcasing policies and initiatives in the **mobility sector**.
 
• The theme of the expo is **“Beyond Boundaries: Co-creating Future Automotive Value Chain”**, focusing on **sustainability** and **technological innovation** in the automotive and mobility industry.
 
• The expo aims to unite the entire **mobility value chain** and is positioned as India's largest **mobility exhibition**.
 
• This year's event will highlight **global significance** with participation from exhibitors and visitors worldwide.
 
• The expo is an **industry-led** and **government-supported initiative**, coordinated by the **Engineering Export Promotion Council of India** with support from various industry bodies and partners.
 
• PM Modi had previously expressed pride in the event for showcasing India’s **automotive innovation**, and announced a **Rs 1 lakh crore investment** in **research and innovation** for the mobility sector, along with expanding **tax exemptions for startups**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India’s automobile sales** surged by **11.6% in 2024**, reaching a record **2.5 crore units**, with **two-wheeler** sales leading the growth at **14.5%**.
 
• **Passenger vehicles** and **three-wheelers** also posted their **highest-ever sales**, contributing to India's position as the **world’s third-largest car market**.

questions.question: How many total Padma Awards have been announced by the Government of India for the year 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**139**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Padma Awards 2025 announced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Padma Awards **- one of the highest civilian Awards of the country, are conferred in three categories, namely, **Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.**
 
• The Awards are given in various disciplines/ fields of activities, viz.- art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, civil service, etc.
 
• **‘Padma Vibhushan’** is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service; **‘Padma Bhushan’** for distinguished service of high order and **‘Padma Shri’** for distinguished service in any field.
 
• The awards are announced on the occasion of Republic Day every year.
 
• These Awards are conferred by the President of India at ceremonial functions which are held at RashtrapatiBhawan usually around March/ April every year. 
 
• For the year 2025, the President has approved conferment of **139 Padma Awards including 1 duo case (in a duo case, the Award is counted as one)**. 
 
• The list comprises **7 Padma Vibhushan**, **19 Padma Bhushan** and **113 Padma Shri Awards**. 
 
• **23 of the awardees are women** and the list also includes **10 persons from the category of Foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI** and **13 Posthumous awardees**.
 
• Go through this link for all the winners: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2096285

questions.question: The Nag Mk 2, a _____-generation Fire-and-Forget Anti-Tank Guided Missile, successfully completed field trials at Pokhran Field Range, achieving targets at both maximum and minimum ranges.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 3rd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Nag Mark 2** is a third-generation, fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile developed by **DRDO**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Successful Trials**: Conducted at the **Pokhran field range in Rajasthan**, the missile destroyed all designated targets at both maximum and minimum range, showcasing its precision.
 
• **Key Features**:
 
 
• Uses **fire-and-forget technology** for modern armoured threats, enabling precision targeting with minimal post-launch intervention.
 
• Can neutralize **armoured vehicles** with explosive reactive armour (ERA).
 
• Successfully integrated with **NAMICA Version 2**, enhancing battlefield mobility and deployment flexibility.
 
 
 
• **Operational Significance**: Enhances India's anti-tank warfare capabilities, addressing evolving armoured threats, especially along national borders.
 
• **Self-Reliance**: The successful testing aligns with India’s **Atmanirbhar Bharat** initiative, advancing self-reliance in defence technology.
 
• **Defence Minister's Remarks**: **Rajnath Singh** praised the achievement, highlighting India's commitment to enhancing domestic defence manufacturing capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://www.hindustantimes.com/ht-img/img/2025/01/13/550x309/ANI-20250113443-0_1736801160473_1736801168471.jpg]

questions.question: Under the National Health Mission (NHM) from 2021 to 2024, how many additional healthcare workers were employed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**12 lakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The National Health Mission (NHM) employed over 12 lakh additional healthcare workers between FY 2021 and FY 2024.**
 
• During this period, a significant focus was placed on strengthening the healthcare infrastructure and workforce to tackle COVID-19 and other health challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **12 lakh additional healthcare workers** were employed under the NHM during FY 2021–24.
 
• **220 crore COVID-19 vaccine doses** were administered during this period, showcasing the country’s large-scale immunization drive.
 
• TB incidence **declined from 237 to 195** per 1,00,000 population between 2015 and 2023.
 
• India achieved **97.98% coverage** in the Measles-Rubella vaccination campaign.
 
• The **PM National Dialysis Programme benefited 4.53 lakh patients** in FY 2023–24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **National Health Mission (NHM)**__

 __
 
• Launched in 2013, the NHM integrates the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) and National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).
 
• Aims to strengthen healthcare infrastructure, improve maternal and child health, and combat communicable and non-communicable diseases.
 
 
 
• **PM National Dialysis Programme**__
 
 
• Provides free or subsidized dialysis services to patients with end-stage renal disease through district hospitals.
 
• Part of the government's initiative to make critical healthcare services accessible and affordable for all.

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India is a ____________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**single-member body.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Article 148** of the Indian Constitution, the **Comptroller and Auditor General of India** is the **country's top auditing body.**
 
• They have the authority to examine every rupee that the **Indian government and the state governments **receive and spend.
 
• The CAG is also the **statutory auditor of Government-owned corporations.**
 
• It performs extra audits of** government-owned businesses **or the **subsidiaries of existing government-owned businesses** in which the government owns at least a** 51 per cent equity stake.**
 
• In terms of precedent, the **CAG** is placed **ninth** and has the same authority as a** sitting Supreme Court of India judge.**
 
• The current** CAG of India is Shri K Sanjay Murthy..​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The** President of India appoints** **India's Comptroller and Auditor-General.**
 
• Through** "The Comptroller and Auditor-General Act, 1971,"** the Indian Parliament sets the CAG's pay and other employment terms.
 
• His** pay **is equal to that of an **Indian Supreme Court Judge.**
 
• He can be removed from office by the president on the same grounds and in the same manner as a judge of the Supreme Court.
 
• The CAG resigns from the position when they reach the **age of 65** or the **end of their six-year term,** whichever comes first, or **through impeachment processes.**​

questions.question: What is India’s global rank in terms of the largest start-up ecosystems as of January 2025?

The correct answer is __**Third.**__

__
 
• **Union Minister of State for Science and Technology (Independent Charge), Dr. Jitendra Singh, said that India has the third-largest start-up ecosystem in the world, with over 100 unicorns that stand as a testament to the nation’s entrepreneurial spirit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the International Court of Justice located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Hague.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is the principal judicial organ of the** United Nations.**
 
• The International Court of Justice was created with an aim to settle the disputes between states in accordance with international law and gives advisory opinions on international legal issues.
 
• It was established in **June 1945** 
 
• It is the successor of the** Permanent** **Court of International Justice (PCIJ).**
 
• As of 2024 August,** Nawaf Salam** is the current President of the** International Court of Justice.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The headquarters of the** United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization****(UNESCO) **is located in **Paris.**
 
• The headquarters of the** International Monetary Fund(IMF)** is located in** Washington, D.C.**
 
• The headquarters of the** United Nations** is located in **New York City.**
